notes.title: Announcement for Version 1.7.0 "Rise to Power" Major Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Magistrates!


[p align="start"]Since resuming updates in May and releasing the latest Version 1.6.0, we believe the current gameplay experience has been optimized to a relatively ideal state, with most known bugs resolved. Now, it’s time to introduce the brand-new gameplay we’ve been designing!


A brand-new Career Mode is coming soon! Many players' long-awaited dream of climbing the ranks is finally here~ We’re calling this major update the "Rise to Power" version.

[p align="start"]What will Career Mode offer? This isn’t just a simple promotion system—it’s a roguelite-inspired challenge! Inspired by our upcoming title, Southern Banquet, this mode will feature randomized elements and unique gameplay variations in each session, promising a fresh and exciting city-building experience.


[p align="start"]Of course, developing this new mode will require more time. Aside from critical bug fixes, we will pause updates for the next two months to focus entirely on creating this new content. 
[p align="start"]

Thanks for your patience and support — stay tuned!

notes.title: Major Update – Reshaping Rivers and Mountains (V1.3.0)
notes.notes:
Dear Magistrates,

After more than a month of development, the highly anticipated Version 1.3.0 update is finally here!

We’ve named this update “Reshaping Rivers and Mountains” because it primarily focuses on improving the core systems and performance of the game—such as housing structure and consumption, happiness calculation, storage mechanics, and more. Gameplay in the early stages has been significantly streamlined to address pacing and balance issues.

Mid-to-late game optimizations, however, will need to wait for the next update—otherwise, we’d never finish QA testing! 😭

If you encounter any bugs or issues after updating, please leave a comment under this announcement.

Below are the main changes in this update:


\[Resource Consumption & Storage System][olist]
Resources are now categorized into Agricultural, Industrial, and Maritime types.

The cart-based transport system has been removed. Granaries, Warehouses, and the Trade Office now only increase their respective storage capacities.

Citizens will automatically collect resources from the nearest warehouse.

Resources consumed to maintain building operations are now directly deducted from warehouse stock.

If warehouse capacity is full or a resource exceeds the storage limit, related buildings will cease production.

Building consumption is now divided into four categories: Fixed, Food, Material, and Additional.

Resource consumption and effects of buildings like Cottages, Farmhouses, Tile Houses, Residences, Guest Houses, Inns, Tea Houses, Markets, Taverns, Theaters, and Mansions have been rebalanced. Check in-game for details.
[/olist]\[Resource Drop Adjustments][olist]
Resources dropped from demolished buildings, defeated enemies, and repelled bandits now go directly into storage—no more hauling by warehouse workers.
[/olist]\[Construction Logic][olist]
Improved pathfinding when building roads—now smarter and more intuitive.

Removed transport capacity limit for builders. As long as resources are sufficient, each resource type only needs to be delivered once. A fixed construction time has been added instead.
[/olist]\[Health][olist]
Reworked how food affects health—now only selected resources determine the health value.

Removed both maximum change speed and target health values—health is now updated instantly and directly based on input.
[/olist]\[Happiness][olist]
Removed happiness range from all buildings. The formula for housing happiness has been redesigned. Different road types now provide different happiness bonuses.

Housing happiness can now exceed 100.
[/olist]\[Commerce][olist]
Removed the Tourism Index.

Taxes from Tea Houses, Inns, Markets, Taverns, Theaters, etc., now scale with the number of employed workers.

Criminals, visitor complaints, and street performers now directly affect tourist attraction, instead of the tourism index.

Removed tourism effects from immortals, advisors, buildings, case judgments, artifacts, and public opinion.
[/olist]\[Commercial Buffs][olist]
Buffs are no longer triggered by fixed building combinations. Now, all connected commercial buildings share a unified “Commercial Value”. When a building becomes inactive due to lacking resources, it will no longer contribute commercial value.

Each commercial building that serves tourists now has buffs based on commercial value.

Buffs are divided into three categories: increased spending, higher food delivery price, and greater tourist attraction.

Higher-tier buildings require greater commercial value to reach maximum buff level, and in return provide more value.
[/olist]\[Buildings][olist]
Houses now consume food, materials, and additional resources. You can choose which to provide, which will affect health, happiness, and income.

Guest Houses function similarly, affecting health, guest capacity, and foreign tax income.

Trade Office no longer handles cart transport—now it only provides maritime functions at a maintenance cost.

Temples and Taoist Shrines now support adjustable workforce.

Temples, Taoist Shrines, and Tianhou Temple consume offerings directly from storage.

Hunters now produce meat based on difficulty level.

Confucian Temple now consumes 1 meat jerky per praying scholar.

Landscape buildings no longer affect happiness range, but can attract tourists.

Charity Burial Grounds no longer require full staffing to send off the deceased and now support adjustable staff.

Theaters no longer need upgrades to unlock street performances. Each play triggers a street performance, and performance income now scales with staff count.

Relay Stations now properly show couriers using ox carts or horse-drawn carts, fixing visual inconsistencies.

Taverns and Theaters now have two new food delivery types.

Artifact Bureau artifacts no longer boost tourism index.

Official Kiln can now choose production outputs freely after research is unlocked.

Mass Graves reduce tourist attraction in the city.
[/olist]\[Personnel][olist]
Lumberjacks will now cancel tasks for unreachable trees.

Removed the following roles: Householders (Homes), Gatekeepers (Confucian Temple), Clan Protectors (Ancestral Hall), Warehouse Clerks (Granaries), Storage Clerks (Warehouses), Overseers (Trade Office), Price Clerks (Exchange Bureau), Curators (Artifact Bureau), Managers (Retirement Home), Shrine Keepers (Tianhou Temple), Receptionists (Guest House), and Servants (Mansion).

Idle citizens will now occasionally stay at home instead of endlessly wandering the streets.

Optimized performance when large numbers of enemies appear simultaneously.
[/olist]\[Research][olist]
Removed research that increased cart numbers for storage buildings.

Removed Trade Office research. New maritime research now boosts shipyard production speed.

Research for Blacksmiths and Kilns has been changed from reducing maintenance to increasing worker slots.
[/olist]\[Wildlife][olist]
Wild animals no longer spawn globally—now only appear near Hunters.
[/olist]\[Visuals & UI][olist]
Improved building range visuals; ranges now appear beneath buildings, no longer using colored overlays.

Improved cloud and water animations for more dynamic effects.

The bottom-left resource panel has been reworked to clearly show agricultural, industrial, and maritime resources.

Optimized production building recipes display.

Removed all tourism index displays.

Idle citizen panel now shows the number of tourists in city and those waiting to enter.

Housing happiness details now include bonuses from charcoal, wine, ceramics, etc. Removed the old happiness range web.

Added tooltips describing the function of each resource consumed by a building.

Updated certain help entries to reflect the changes.

Updated certain stats entries to match new systems.
[/olist]\[Custom Difficulty & Map Editor][olist]
Wildlife spawn option is now renamed as Hunter Efficiency.

Removed wild animal modules from the Map Editor.

Dynamic clouds and water now take effect automatically when starting a map.
[/olist]\[Other Adjustments][olist]
With the removal of tourism value, some story-triggering conditions for famous NPCs have been revised.

Adjusted how Health, Happiness, and Reputation influence each other.

Adjusted starting resources in Story and Endless Mode.

Tweaked how Heavy Taxes affect happiness.

Adjusted trade prices for maritime resources.

Adjusted food delivery prices.

Rebalanced resource costs and deity effects for Temples and Shrines.

Adjusted how happiness levels affect immigration.

Tweaked max staff limits for some buildings.

Adjusted maintenance costs, removed maintenance for commercial buildings, increased it for wonders and high-tier buildings.

Ship blueprints can now be purchased only once and are not lost in shipwrecks.

Rebalanced tourist spending and fixed resource consumption for all commercial buildings.

Adjusted advisor wages.

Modified rewards tied to the tourism index.

Achievement \[Grand Slam] now requires Health, Happiness, and Reputation to all reach 100.

Achievement \[Twice the Results] now requires your Theater to reach max commercial buff level.
[/olist]\[Bug Fixes][olist]
Fixed prestige errors when offering Official or Imperial Porcelain.

Fixed an issue where celebrity animations could be skipped by clicking.

Fixed audience count not updating in Theater interface.

Fixed storage upgrade bugs with Granaries and Warehouses before and after research.

Fixed shipwreck effects not working properly during maritime events.
[/olist]

notes.title: Instructions for Accessing the Old Version (V1.2.1R)
notes.notes:
Dear County Magistrates,

The new version V1.3.0 of Song of Blooming Courtyards is now live!
Please note that due to underlying framework changes, save files from the old version V1.2.1R are not compatible with the new update.

If you'd like to continue your old save, you can switch to the previous version branch on Steam by following these steps:

Step 1: Locate the game in your Steam Library and click "Properties".
Step 2: In the "Betas" tab, select the branch version-1.2.1r from the dropdown menu.
Step 3: After setting it, check if the game name in your library shows the branch suffix — if so, the switch was successful.

If you wish to return to the latest version later, simply go back to the "Betas" tab and select "None" to opt out of beta testing.

We wish you continued joy in the world of Song — may your ideal little Song Dynasty town flourish!

notes.title: Major Update Delay Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Esteemed Magistrates,


We owe you an apology — the major update will be delayed.



It’s not that we don’t want to finish, it’s that we literally can’t finish it on time. When we wrote the last preview of the upcoming update, we didn’t fully realize just how interconnected everything is. One tweak leads to another, and it turned out to be a much bigger overhaul than we expected — especially with the underlying gameplay logic changes.



But hey, it’s not all bad news —

After the major update, even with 5,000 people on screen, it won’t lag anymore!

Don't just take our word for it — check out the latest gameplay demo: \[Watch the New Demo]



Current Development Progress Summary:
[olist]
Programming functionality: 70% complete

UI adjustments: 50% complete

Production/consumption balancing: still in progress, as we've just started internal testing

6 bugs from the previous version: still pending fixes

A bunch of sneaky new bugs from the new version: lurking in the shadows, waiting to be squashed...
[/olist]
All in all, we’re now aiming to release the major update around late July.


Thanks for your patience and support — stay tuned!

notes.title: Update v1.2.1 & Important Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Governors,

Good news! We've fixed the bug that caused cargo and crew members to randomly disappear during sailing.

P.S.
We've recently received feedback about certain game features not working as intended. Upon investigation, many of these issues are related to outdated Mods. Since Mods don’t automatically adapt to newer game versions, using older Mods may lead to incompatibilities. We strongly recommend checking whether a Mod is still actively maintained before subscribing to it.

Important Announcement

After our previous update, we noticed some players were concerned about the upcoming major update potentially making old save files incompatible. Since we didn’t fully explain the nature of the major update last time, some players might be confused as to why a save reset is necessary if it’s "just an experience optimization."

We’d like to take this opportunity to clarify what's coming and why it matters. Here are some of the key features currently in development:

1. Reworked warehouse system – removing the cumbersome supply-demand hauling mechanic.

2. Removed landlords from all residential buildings, increasing each citizen’s productivity and improving city efficiency.

3. Adjusted resource consumption logic for all housing, making resource usage more efficient and giving players more flexibility in resource management.

4. Optimized worker allocations across all existing buildings.

5. Redesigned happiness-related mechanics, allowing for more flexibility in managing population and resources.

6. Revamped commercial building buffs, removing strict combo requirements and offering more freedom in building layout.

7. Improved visual effects for water and fog.

8. Updated builder hauling logic and adjusted build time mechanics to fix the frustrating “construction lock” experience.

9. Rebuilt hunting mechanics and improved wildlife generation, which is expected to enhance performance and reduce lag.

We believe these changes will bring a major improvement to the overall gameplay experience. Our intention is to rebuild the core of the game, laying a solid foundation for future content such as the Maritime Expedition and Imperial Examination systems, which are already on our roadmap.

Yes, we acknowledge that this means older designs were far from perfect. With the experience we've gained since launch, we’re confident that we can make The Grand Estate (满庭芳) a much better, more polished, and more enjoyable game. But to do this properly, we need to rethink and rework some foundational systems.

That’s why we’ve decided that delivering a fresh new gameplay experience is our top priority. Older save files will remain compatible with the previous branch of the game, but they won’t be supported in the new update. Supporting old saves would require a massive amount of additional development effort—effort we feel is better spent on refining and enhancing the game itself.

We genuinely believe this new version of the game will offer a much richer experience, and we’re excited for you to explore this new and improved version of the Song Dynasty city you’ve come to love.

Of course, this is just our perspective as the developers. If you strongly disagree with this direction, feel free to leave your thoughts in the discussion forums. If a significant number of players voice their support for keeping save file compatibility, we’ll consider prioritizing that instead. However, please understand that this would double (or more) the time needed to roll out the planned updates.

We’ll continue to improve the game and do our best to address any issues that arise. Your feedback is always welcome.

Thank you for your understanding and continued support!

notes.title: Development Team Update + Bug Feedback Survey
notes.notes:
Development Team Update + Bug Feedback Survey

Hello, dear city builders!

It has been 4 months since the official release. While we have been continuously listening to your feedback and fixing bugs, we are also working on a new project in parallel.

Given the technical capacity and productivity of our small team, we’ve now completed our overall concept for Majesty in the Thriving City: Song. Thus, we released the full version. We’ve refined this "Small Song Dynasty City" to the best of our abilities.

If you, our builders, have any other brilliant ideas, feel free to fill out the survey and let us know! → Survey Link. We truly appreciate all your feedback.→https://wj.qq.com/s2/15338785/b756/ 
We truly appreciate all your feedback.

And what about bugs? Please head over to the survey as well! Just a reminder: bug reports need to include your save file. Without it, our programmers may find it hard to replicate and fix the issues!

As we are working on a new project in parallel, we haven't been able to devote much time to maintaining the community's group chats. A big shout-out to our community managers—Hua Xiaozhou, Mufan, Jiang Yanqing, Jingxian, Shoushou SaySo—for tirelessly responding to everyone. Also, many thanks to our veteran players who help answer questions in the group. Your love is the greatest fortune for the White Star Studio development team!

Thanks to all the players who love Majesty in the Thriving City: Song!

notes.title: Update Frequency in the Future
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, have you come to build your own twon during the May Day holiday?

We collected various problems that you might encounter recently, and a lot of bug had been fixed one after another. And the optimization in subsequent updates can be seen ——https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1956800/view/3707068460686645169
Details are included in this announcement.

 In the following time, we will update the game at a frequency of about once a week to improve and optimize the game.

However! If we encounter a vicious bug that has a major impact, it will take more time and more our effort to fix it. We beg for your foegiveness if the update is late. 

At present, we are going all out to improve the game, and hope to work with you to build "Thriving City: Song" into an ideal and prosperous Great Song.

If you have any suggestions and feedback, please contact with administrators in the Discord channel!

notes.title: it's now confirmed that the early access version will be relaesed on April 21!
notes.notes:
Thank you so much for your patience and support, it's now confirmed that the early access version will be relaesed on April 21! Are you ready to start this journey of the "Small Town in the Great Song"?

It took more than two years to devote all our efforts. "Thriving City: Song" will finally meet with you soon.

From the laying of bricks and tiles on the road to the flowers and trees in front of the court, every plant and tree is drawn by us, and the population allocation and numerical design of all walks of life have been debugged countless times.However, the game is still in the state of early access, and there are still many things to be improved. We are extremely expecting your feedback and suggestions! Let us make this "Great Song" an ideal world together.

As for the demo that everyone is concerned about, we will announce the latest situation on Steam and on #EASTERN GAME FEST# of Steam on April 12th!

We hope our "Thriving City: Song" can bring you a happy game experience!

Thank you again for your long waiting, we will see you on April 21st!
